language_task: pick up the red block and put it in the bowl
outcome_evidence: The robot approaches and grasps the red block, then lifts and carries it toward the bowl (frames 119–162, cam_2_scene, cam_3_wrist and cam_4_wrist). It releases the block into the bowl at frames 163–168; the block settles inside and remains there through frame 195 while the gripper withdraws, visible in all three cameras. No failed attempt or unintended side effect is established.
